proposed_widenings.name: spell_effect_reference_with_overrides
proposed_widenings.justification: A magic item activation needs to apply an existing spell's authored effect directly, rather than grant cast access, while overriding bounded lifecycle fields.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you drink this potion, you gain the effect of the Gaseous Form spell for 1 hour (no Concentration required)

proposed_widenings.name: manual_end_as_bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The applied spell effect needs an explicit user-invoked early-end control tied to a Bonus Action; existing duration early-end triggers only describe automatic event endings.
proposed_widenings.evidence: or until you end the effect as a Bonus Action

notes: Did not author content JSON/Dhall because using grant_spell_access would be dishonest: the potion applies Gaseous Form immediately instead of letting the user cast it.
